en: Greetings, $c - I'm a Commendation Officer acting on behalf of Darnassus.  It is my duty to assist adventurers who have received Alliance Commendation Signets.$B$BI accept signets in different quantities, but the most beneficial exchange for you is to hand in a set of ten at once.  I will enter your deeds into our records when you hand in your signets.  As a result, you will earn recognition from Darnassus for your duty and service.

While my brother, Drazial, focuses his analysis on the more physical nature of the beasts of the blasted lands, I tend to focus on the more cerebral and spiritual aspects of the wildlife.$B$BIt is true that the beasts exhibit extremely unusual strength, agility, and stamina, but some of them also possess great intelligence and regenerative abilities, untied to their physical being.$B$BPerhaps you would be interested in helping advance my research, $r?
If you want her back you're gonna have to beg!
May da spirits protect you mon.
Meet me down by the orchard--I just need to put my gun away.
If you need to house your pet while you're training another, then you should talk to Jenova Stoneshield over in the Dwarven District.
You must be looking for Smith Argus.  He's usually overseeing the forge in Goldshire if you need some training.
%s explodes and releases several Bile Slimes!
Something tells me this $n wants the mysterious fossil too. Help!
No, I'm not, but lots of others are looking for love.  You should buy my love tokens, put on some cologne or perfume, and then pass them around!
I regret that I must fight this $n.
The Shattered Hand will see the Horde to their former glory, unhindered by the timidness of the Warchief.
Major Domo Enabled.

Welcome to our humble abode!  It's always nice to see a friendly face.  And what strong arms you have.  My husband and I are always looking for help around the farm.  Now that most the good folk have left, it's hard to find an able body to help out.
I not-so-quietly ignore the insult, hoping to instill a fear in the ruler that he may have gaffed.  I then inform my liege of the insult when I return.
Ok, let's get started.
Hello, $n.
Rest now, my daughter.
Alright, everything looks in order. Let's get this show on the road.
Aye sure, just as long as we get to hit the arena right after!
%s goes into a frenzy at the sight of his fallen troops.
The Blackrock infestation is thick in these parts.  I will do my best to keep the pace, $N.  Let's go!
I am unable to teach a Tauren to ride a Skeletal Mount.  I am sorry but there is nothing I can do for you.
You show wisdom beyond your years, $c.  Thank you. You can find our battlemaster, Lylandris, standing at the war table in the Hall of Arms. She can assist you in traveling to Warsong Gulch.
When I clawed my way out of the grave, I thought my family would welcome me with open arms. Instead, they drove me from the village, screaming in a language I could no longer understand.
Um... I think you're a little too big to ride a Mechano-strider there, $g mister : ma'am;.  You'd likely crush the finely tuned servo-balancers!
You are truly a determined student. I will be happy to provide you with instruction!
Miranda, could you please tell me the insignia cost of items that you are offering for adventurers of honored reputation?
Finished!  And the results are amazing.  I must convey them to my associates Grimand, Mathiel and Klockmort!

I represent the strength which bolsters you as a young $c.  You have come to me to learn this strength, young one, and I will teach this to you.  I will teach you all that is the spirit bear, provided you will listen and understand.

In order to know what it means to draw upon my spirit, you need to understand the importance of the strength of the body, as well as the strength of the heart.
Lunch has arrived, my beautiful children. Tear them to pieces!
Believe me when I tell you this: You're gonna wish you weren't born, sissy!

Please do see that he reads it at once. I fear our Scourge problem has only just begun.

Come see me again in due time. I believe I have nearly uncovered something I could use a willing blade to help with.

Indeed. The item was ultimately destroyed and Deathwing nearly slain by the combined and renewed power of the four remaining Aspects. Where Deathwing is now is unknown. What we do know, however, is that one of his progeny, Nefarian, rules this citadel and wishes to continue where his father left off.
Dun Baldar took a real beating in the last Horde attack!  We need more supplies in order to rebuild and make repairs!
Off to the Undercity with you, $n! Try not to catch the plague...
There we go!
Now is the time, Davil.  Now is the time of your death!
Ye've come further than many, $N. Respect the elements around ye and ye shall fare far greater than most.
They say an army travels on its stomach, and that's the truth.  For any offensive to succeed, your troops have to be well-fed and well supplied.
Hidey ho $g sir : miss;. I would watch your step around here, I lost a bomb disguised as a mouse and I can't seem to find it.
Come, spirits - attend your master!
Astounding!  So then indurium is the key!
Literacy should be celebrated and shared.
The Dark Lady's followers are blind to think they can stand against our might.
Is that all? I thought you were going to challenge me.
Mom! Can we go play please please please? Can we huh? Can we?
